pick a fight: Angry after losing the game, he tried to pick a fight with anyone who spoke to him.
他輸了比賽後心情很差，所以想找任何跟他說話的人吵架。
pick holes in: My older sister always likes to pick holes in my plans, saying they will never work.
我姊姊總愛對我的計畫挑毛病，說它們永遠行不通。
pick up speed: As the train left the station, it began to pick up speed and soon the city disappeared behind us.
火車離開車站後開始加速，城市很快就消失在我們身後。
pick up a language: Young children can pick up a language quickly just by playing with friends who speak it every day.
小孩子只要每天和說那種語言的朋友玩，就能很快學會那種語言。
pick one's brain: Since you have studied abroad, can I pick your brain about how to apply to universities in the UK?
既然你出國留學過，我可以向你請教如何申請英國的大學嗎？
pick up the pieces: After the typhoon destroyed their farm, the family had to pick up the pieces and start their lives again.
颱風摧毀他們的農場後，這家人必須收拾殘局，重新開始生活。
pick on someone: It is wrong to pick on someone just because they look different or speak with an accent.
只因為別人外表不同或說話有口音就找他麻煩，是不對的。
pick up the tab: Don't worry about the money tonight; my boss said he would pick up the tab for everyone's dinner.
今晚別擔心錢的事；我老闆說他會幫大家的晚餐買單。
picture oneself as: When she was a child, she would often picture herself as a famous singer standing on a big stage.
她小時候常常想像自己是站在大舞台上的知名歌手。
picture the scene: Close your eyes and picture the scene: a quiet beach, warm sand, and the sound of soft waves.
閉上眼睛，想像這個場景：安靜的海灘、溫暖的沙子，以及輕柔的海浪聲。
get the picture: You don't have to explain it again; I get the picture, and I will be more careful next time.
你不用再解釋了；我明白了，下次我會更小心。
the big picture: Don't worry so much about one bad quiz; try to look at the big picture and focus on your whole year.
別太擔心一次小考考差；試著看大局，專注在你整個學年的表現。
can't picture it: My grandpa says he used to be a rock star, but I can't picture it because he is so quiet now.
我爺爺說他以前是搖滾明星，但我無法想像，因為他現在好安靜。
pile on the pressure: Before the final exam, some parents pile on the pressure, making their kids feel even more nervous.
期末考前，有些家長會施加壓力，讓孩子更加緊張。
pile up debts: If you keep using your credit card without a plan, you will pile up debts that are hard to pay back.
如果你沒有計畫地一直刷信用卡，就會累積很難還清的債務。
work piles up: If I take a week off, my work piles up on my desk and I have to stay late for days.
如果我請一週假，工作就會在我桌上堆積如山，我得連續好幾天加班。
pile into the car: After the concert ended, all six of us had to pile into the car because we couldn't find a taxi.
演唱會結束後，我們六個人都得擠進車裡，因為叫不到計程車。
pile on the pounds: During the Lunar New Year holiday, many people pile on the pounds because they eat so much delicious food.
農曆新年期間，很多人體重暴增，因為吃了太多美食。
pilot a project: Before using the new app in every school, the city will pilot a project in three schools to test it.
在所有學校使用這款新應用程式之前，市政府會先在三所學校試行專案來測試。
pilot a plane: My cousin trained for years so that she could pilot a plane and fly passengers around the world.
我表姊受訓多年，就是為了能駕駛飛機，載乘客飛往世界各地。
a pilot study: The scientists ran a pilot study with only twenty students before starting the larger research project.
科學家在展開較大型的研究計畫之前，先只用二十名學生做了一個先導研究。
pilot the bill through: The experienced lawmaker worked hard to pilot the bill through the legislature before the end of the year.
這位資深立委努力在年底前推動法案在立法院通過。
pin one's hopes on: The coach decided to pin his hopes on the young player, believing she could score the winning goal.
教練決定寄望於這位年輕球員，相信她能踢進致勝的一球。
pin the blame on: When the vase broke, my brother tried to pin the blame on the cat, but Mom knew the truth.
花瓶破掉時，我弟弟想把責任推給貓，但媽媽知道真相。
pin down the details: We have agreed to go to Tainan for the trip, but we still need to pin down the details like hotels.
我們已經同意去台南旅行，但仍需要確定像飯店這類的細節。
pin someone down: I asked him three times when he would return my book, but it is hard to pin him down on a date.
我問了他三次何時要還我書，但很難逼他表態說出確切日期。
pins and needles: We were on pins and needles all afternoon, waiting for the teacher to announce the results of the contest.
我們整個下午都坐立不安，等著老師宣布比賽結果。
pioneer a technique: The doctor became famous because she was the first to pioneer a technique for safer heart surgery.
這位醫生之所以出名，是因為她是第一個開創更安全心臟手術技術的人。
pioneer research: Many years ago, she pioneered research into clean energy when few other scientists were interested in it.
許多年前，在很少其他科學家感興趣的時候，她就開拓了潔淨能源的研究。
pioneer the use of: This small hospital was the first to pioneer the use of robots to help nurses deliver medicine.
這家小醫院率先使用機器人協助護理師遞送藥物。
